{{Nihongo|Mukumuku|ムクムク|Mukumuku}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]''. It is the legendary snow monster based on Yeti.

Mukumuku is only available during Winter night, where he can be found in the Goddess Spring area. He is referred by the "Guardian of the Forest". Once you befriend Mukumuku, he will give you 1 record for every fish you give him.

==Events==
{{InfoNeeded|More events}}
'''Mukumuku's Gift'''<ref>[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan6/events/a2_mukugift.php Mukumuku's Gift - Harvest Moon: DS (Other Event)] fogu.com</ref>

Exit your house between 6am to 12pm during sunny winter. Mukumuku has 100 FP or more and you must have nothing in the green slot of your rucksack. He will give you a Large Fish.

{{Clr}}
----

'''Mukumuku's Sickness'''<ref>[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan6/events/mukumuku_sick.php Mukumuku's Sickness - Harvest Moon: DS (Other Event)] fogu.com</ref>

Walk from Main Pathway Area to Goddess' Spring in Winter season when Mukumuku has 200 FP or more. You also must have a Poisonous Mushroom in your rucksack leftover from Fall.

When Mukumuku takes the gift, he will feel unwell so you take him to the clinic.Hardy will severely scold you for getting Mukumuku sick. He demands that you do not feed it any more of whatever you had gave it before. Hardy will then send you home to think about the bad thing you have done.

==Trivia==
*Mukumuku is a Japanese onomatopoeia meaning "shaggy" or "hairy".
